rights.output_description: independent generic plan-view ASCII biped/root-support rig following an authored S-curve

novelty.new_causality: A running root crosses one S-curve inflection while forward speed remains alive. Curve-A inward demand and COM bank unwind toward zero on continued alternating support; the opposite curvature sign appears only after the authored zero-curvature catch, then builds through subsequent catches. Gait phase never resets and the exit pays residual torso/yaw/bank lag while still traveling.
failure_if: bank sign flips before curvature zero or without an earning support catch
heading reverses by in-place pivot or phase reset
root speed clamps at the inflection
support ownership teleports instead of alternating catch/pass pairs
the S path collapses into a straight endpoint tween
entry and exit are identical idle poses
torso/head instantly match root yaw through the sign swap with no secondary lag

timing.playback_policy: authored decisive causal keys with explicit ONES/TWOS exposure; no generic endpoint interpolation; no reverse interpolation

rig.support_rule: A support catch owns a world-space foot anchor through its following pass/unload key; opposite foot is free until next catch.
rig.bank_rule: Signed COM offset is authored relative to the tangent; sign may reverse only after the zero-curvature join and an opposite-support catch.

rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: The first authored route made bank-sign reversal coincide with a path height apex while root yaw continued rotating the same direction; it did not visibly prove a true curvature-sign reversal. Long world-locked support spans also made the catch/pass relation read like a rubber tether rather than a running support window.
rounds.concrete_correction: Reauthor SAME 022 K00-K14 root/yaw/bank/support geometry so root yaw-rate decreases through curve A, reaches a zero-curvature join at K06, then reverses sign only after that earned right catch; compress per-support root travel and enlarge the abstract body/COM offset so support custody remains legible.

rounds.inspection: Decoded the 27-frame 480×270 H.264/yuv420p render as a full timing sheet. Root translation stays positive through the S route; curve-A bank/support demand grows then unwinds; K06 is an earned right-foot zero-curvature catch with neutral bank while torso yaw still lags; K07 only probes the opposite sign after that catch; K08 left catch decisively owns the sign swap; curve-B builds through K09-K11; K12-K14 unwind into a displaced running tangent. Alternating catch/pass anchors remain physically bounded and world-fixed within each support window. No support teleport, in-place pivot, root stop, equal-spacing gait loop, straight endpoint tween, reverse interpolation, or idle reset is visible.

Same actual final render plus complete ASCII/JSON specimen. The plan-oblique presentation makes the two causal joins readable: bank debt is paid to neutral before the inflection, then opposite-bank authority is earned by support rather than painted on. Torso yaw visibly trails root yaw through the swap and exit. The result is a specific S-turn locomotion sentence, not a reskinned run cycle or decorative route diagram.
